description: Read the Bitcoin (OpenTimestamps) anchoring record for the ledger's Merkle roots. Defaults to action:'history', which is read-only and returns each anchor transaction with its txid, block height, confirmation state and how many ledger entries it covers. Pass action:'verify' with a txid to check one transaction, or action:'anchor' to explicitly request that pending roots be aggregated and submitted to the OTS calendars. Defaults to 'history' so a routine call never triggers a batch write. An anchor counts as confirmed only when a real Bitcoin block contains it. Read-only for action 'history' and 'verify'; only action 'anchor' writes, by submitting pending roots to the OTS calendars. Output: a JSON list of anchor transactions with txid, block height and confirmation state. A failure returns a tool error whose text is JSON: { success: false, error }.

action.description: 'history' reads the anchored transactions (default); 'verify' checks one txid; 'anchor' explicitly requests anchoring of pending roots

txid.description: Bitcoin transaction id — required only when action is 'verify'
